children: Swiss private equity heavyweight Partners Group
reported a net half-year profit of 502 million Swiss francs ($620 million) on Tuesday, down 13% year-on-year, following turmoil around its open-ended funds that hit shares.
The company also announced that CEO David Layton will step down from the executive team. Roberto Cagnati and Juri Jenkner will be appointed co-CEOs, Partners Group said.
